acceptance.given: A Toolchain aggregate execution is running under its bounded execution controls.

oracle.expected: The aggregate reaches a deterministically identified terminal state; exhaustion of its execution budget is unsuccessful.
forbidden: The aggregate ends in an indeterminate or nondeterministic terminal state.
oracle.observable: The aggregate execution result exposes one deterministic terminal state after the bounded execution ends.

acceptance.then: The aggregate is in a deterministic terminal state.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Execute a bounded aggregate path that would otherwise end without a deterministic terminal verdict and require a red unsuccessful outcome.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Make each bounded Toolchain aggregate execution emit a deterministic terminal state and classify budget exhaustion as unsuccessful.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: No persisted state or schema change; revert restores prior Toolchain aggregate terminal-state handling.

slice_hint.state_transition: aggregate executing -> deterministic successful or unsuccessful terminal state
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Every completed aggregate exposes a deterministic terminal state, and budget exhaustion is unsuccessful.

acceptance.given: A repository-relative v2 replay-matrix input contains a Matrix Case that requests the expected-difference terminal category, its case expectation declaration, Stable and Candidate execution inputs, and separate execution/evidence fields.

oracle.expected: The matrix receipt reports expected-difference only when that exact case declares the difference as frozen and both subject executions plus all required identity, execution, and evidence gates are present and valid; the aggregate remains unsuccessful if the observed difference is a regression.
forbidden: An unfrozen expected difference is accepted.
Expected-difference bypasses a missing execution or evidence gate.
A regression is approved through expected-difference.
oracle.observable: The replay-matrix receipt and aggregate exit status identify the case classification, gate outcomes, and rejection of any invalid expected-difference request.

acceptance.then: The receipt admits only the frozen, fully evidenced non-regression difference; every other requested expected-difference case makes the aggregate fail.
acceptance.when: scripts/sc/skill_package_replay.py evaluates the Matrix Case through replay-matrix.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Mutate the existing replay-matrix test input so a case reports expected-difference without that case's frozen expectation, and assert aggregate rejection.
Use the existing replay-matrix test selector with a frozen expected-difference case missing one required subject execution or evidence binding, and assert aggregate rejection.
Use the existing replay-matrix test selector with a frozen expected-difference label whose observed Stable/Candidate comparison is regressive, and assert that it cannot produce aggregate success.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Make replay-matrix treat expected-difference as a case-scoped constrained terminal result: admit it only after verifying that the exact Matrix Case froze the difference and that all required Stable/Candidate execution and evidence gates pass; reject it, and prevent aggregate success, when the freeze is absent, any gate is absent or invalid, or the difference is regressive.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Preserve existing v2 matrix pass/fail and terminal-category behavior for cases that do not request expected-difference; only add the fail-closed, case-frozen expected-difference rule without reinterpreting any existing failure as success.

slice_hint.state_transition: A Matrix Case classified as expected-difference moves from an unconstrained terminal-category path to either an admitted frozen-and-fully-gated non-regression result or an aggregate-failing rejection.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: replay-matrix returns aggregate success with an expected-difference case only if that exact case has a frozen expected difference, complete valid execution and evidence gates, and a non-regressive comparison; otherwise it returns a non-success aggregate result.

acceptance.given: A detached negative Probe is configured to report success despite a false-negative condition.

oracle.expected: Acceptance evaluation classifies the always-success false-negative Probe as failed.
oracle.observable: The independent Probe evaluation reports a failed Probe outcome for the always-success false-negative condition.

acceptance.then: Always-success false negatives are reported as failures.
acceptance.when: The Toolchain Probe evaluator checks the detached negative Probe outcome.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Evaluate an always-success detached negative Probe and require the Probe-contract validation to fail if it is treated as passing.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Enforce the detached-Probe contract so an always-success false negative is classified as a failed Probe outcome.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: No persisted state or schema change; revert restores prior Toolchain Probe evaluation behavior.

slice_hint.state_transition: always-success false-negative Probe presented -> failed Probe outcome
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The evaluator emits a failed Probe outcome for an always-success false negative; it cannot be accepted as passing.

acceptance.given: A Matrix Case observation is bound to evidence whose label differs from its frozen case identity.

oracle.expected: The aggregate is marked invalid and cannot be accepted.
forbidden: The aggregate remains valid or is accepted despite mislabeled matrix evidence.
oracle.observable: Aggregate-evaluation output records invalid matrix evidence attributable to the mismatched label.

acceptance.then: The aggregate is invalid because matrix evidence is mislabeled.
acceptance.when: The S7 aggregate-evaluation selector evaluates the mislabeled Matrix Case evidence.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Run the S7 aggregate test with Matrix Case evidence whose label disagrees with its frozen identity; validation must fail.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Invalidate aggregate evaluation when any Matrix Case evidence is mislabeled.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: No persisted-state or schema migration; rollback restores the prior aggregate-evaluation behavior.

slice_hint.state_transition: Aggregate evaluated with mislabeled evidence -> aggregate invalid and not acceptable.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The S7 test observes an invalid aggregate for mislabeled evidence and no acceptance-success outcome.
